node.title: Command Switch -i prints to screen not file
node.author: BillKSmith
node.doctext:
I planned to recommend that [skjeiu] use the [doc://perlrun#Command-switch] (-i~) in his solution to [id://11125925]. My test case did not work as expected. The input file was correctly renamed as the backup. A new file was created with the original name. However, the print function sent its output to the screen rather than the file. What am I missing? #!perl -i.bak my @input = <>; if (!scalar grep {/Friday/} @input) { splice @input, 1, 0, "Friday\n"; } print @input;

using Strawberry perl on windows 7

perl -v This is perl 5, version 30, subversion 2 (v5.30.2) built for MSWin32-x64-multi-t hread
Bill
